required_documents.name: SF-424 Application for Federal Domestic Assistance
required_documents.details: Official federal assistance application signed by the authorized organizational representative.

required_documents.name: SF-424C Budget Information (Construction) and SF-424D Assurances
required_documents.details: Required for development/construction and land acquisition park projects (SF-424A/B used for non-construction).

required_documents.name: Project Abstract Summary (OMB 4040-0019)
required_documents.details: Plain-language overview stating purpose, activities, deliverables, beneficiaries, and subrecipients.

required_documents.name: Project Narrative
required_documents.details: Under 10 pages, font 11 or larger, 1-inch margins. Must include Project Data Page, Project Overview, and Responses to Merit Review Criteria.

required_documents.name: Budget Narrative & Detailed Budget Spreadsheet
required_documents.details: Itemized justification of all allowable costs, matching funds, and completion of the Detailed_Budget_LWCF_Grants.xlsx spreadsheet. Administrative costs capped at 7%.

required_documents.name: Indirect Cost Rate Agreement (NICRA)
required_documents.details: Required if claiming negotiated indirect rates; alternatively state use of 15% de minimis rate under 2 CFR 200.414(f).

required_documents.name: Project Timeline
required_documents.details: Maximum 1 page detailing milestone schedule, contract bidding dates, construction phases, and opening date.

required_documents.name: Project Site Map(s) and Rendering(s)
required_documents.details: High-resolution maps showing exact site boundaries, surrounding community, access points, and architectural renderings of proposed improvements.

required_documents.name: Letters of Commitment for Non-Federal Cost Share
required_documents.details: Signed commitment letters confirming source and availability of 1:1 non-federal matching funds from local government, foundation, or donor.

required_documents.name: Overlap or Duplication of Effort Statement
required_documents.details: Statement disclosing any overlapping federal applications or awards for the same project activities.

required_documents.name: Uniform Audit Reporting Statement
required_documents.details: Confirmation of compliance with Single Audit Act requirements under 2 CFR 200 Subpart F.

required_documents.name: SAM.gov UEI and Grants.gov Workspace Registration
required_documents.details: Active registration in SAM.gov with verified UEI and active Grants.gov account.

deadlines.when: November 1 each year (annually through 2030), 11:59 p.m. ET
Submit to NC SPOC prior to federal deadline if required

eligibility.summary: State Lead Agencies are directly eligible. In North Carolina, NC Department of Natural and Cultural Resources (DNCR) / Division of Parks and Recreation submits applications on behalf of local government subrecipients. Projects must be located in an urban area with population of 25,000 or more (e.g. Charlotte, Raleigh, Greensboro, Durham, Asheville, Fayetteville, Wilmington).

cost_share.details: Mandatory dollar-for-dollar 50% non-federal matching requirement. Grant funds cover up to 50% of project costs; applicant must provide at least 50% from non-federal sources.

review_criteria.criterion: Criterion 1 – Increasing Access to Outdoor Recreation Opportunities
Criterion 3 – Leveraging Resources in Support of Recreation
Criterion 4 – Promoting Conservation and Ecological Benefits

submission_limits: States may nominate multiple qualifying local government projects per annual cycle.
important_notes: Perpetuity Requirement: Assisted park sites must be dedicated and accessible for public outdoor recreation in perpetuity under Section 6(f)(3) of the Land and Water Conservation Fund Act.
Projects must be situated within a Census-defined urban area having a population of 25,000 or greater.
Project Narrative is strictly limited to 10 pages; excess pages will be excluded from review.
Administrative costs cannot exceed 7% of total award funds.
